adjudication.rationale: In `RestAdapter.basePath`, the new check `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(type.replace('_', '-')) !== -1` only replaces the first underscore. If a model type ever contains multiple underscores (e.g. `foo_bar_baz`), it would not be fully dasherized and therefore would not match an `ADMIN_MODELS` entry like `foo-bar-baz`, causing the adapter to return the non-admin base path (`"/"`). The diff does not show any currently-used admin model types with multiple underscores, so this is a concrete edge-case concern but not a verifiable broken behavior from the shown changes alone.
